subject: Lean and Mathlib back Alpöge's Riemann proof, OpenAI shares models' perplexity
notes: Issue is headed 'Sun, Nov 22'. Headlines only; no event dates stated.

stories.headline: Amazon reported to be nearing a $7.5B deal to buy AI startup Decart
stories.quote: SOURCES: AMAZON IS NEARING A $7.5B DEAL TO BUY AI STARTUP DECART; TALKS ARE AT AN ADVANCED STAGE AND A DEAL COULD COME TOGETHER AS SOON AS NEXT WEEK

stories.headline: Masayoshi Son explored a possible $1T buyout of SK Hynix; SoftBank says it is no longer under active consideration
stories.quote: SOURCES: MASAYOSHI SON RECENTLY EXPLORED A POSSIBLE $1T BUYOUT OF SK HYNIX; SOFTBANK SAYS THE DEAL IS “NO LONGER UNDER ACTIVE CONSIDERATION”

stories.headline: Anthropic reported to have restricted its IPO banks over leak fears
stories.quote: SOURCES: AMID LEAK FEARS, ANTHROPIC LIMITED SOME IPO BANKS TO FOUR-PERSON TEAMS, USED A VIEW-LOGGING FILE PLATFORM, AND SOUGHT SIX-MONTH BANS ON ADVISING RIVALS

stories.headline: Lean and Mathlib communities say they have full confidence Alpöge's proof of the Riemann hypothesis is correct
stories.quote: A JOINT STATEMENT BY THE LEAN AND MATHLIB COMMUNITIES SAYS “WE HAVE FULL CONFIDENCE THAT ALPÖGE'S PROOF OF THE RIEMANN HYPOTHESIS IS CORRECT”

facts.text: NYU's Tristan Buckmaster and Anthropic's Levent Alpöge published an AI-aided proof of Navier-Stokes blowup
facts.quote: NYU'S TRISTAN BUCKMASTER AND ANTHROPIC'S LEVENT ALPÖGE PUBLISH AN AI-AIDED PROOF OF NAVIER-STOKES BLOWUP, SAYING IT CLOSES A LOOPHOLE IN OPENAI'S SOLUTION

stories.headline: OpenAI shares its models' perplexity and urges pacing limits based on such metrics
stories.quote: OPENAI SHARES ITS MODELS' PERPLEXITY, OR HOW WELL THEY PREDICT DATA, AND URGES PACING LIMITS BASED ON SUCH METRICS, CITING A POSSIBLE 2027 AVALANCHE OF AI GAINS

stories.headline: Researchers found AI routers such as OpenRouter and Vercel often broke privacy promises, with keys stolen
stories.quote: RESEARCHERS USED CANARY CREDENTIALS IN REQUESTS TO AI ROUTERS LIKE OPENROUTER AND VERCEL, EVEN UNDER “ZDR” POLICIES, AND SAW “PRIVACY” OFTEN BROKEN, KEYS STOLEN

stories.headline: FBI reported to be investigating an apparent breach of its NCIC database
stories.quote: SOURCES: THE FBI IS INVESTIGATING AN APPARENT BREACH OF ITS NCIC DATABASE, WHICH IS USED BY LAW ENFORCEMENT TO SHARE INFO ON WARRANTS AND BACKGROUND CHECKS

stories.headline: Jay Clayton reported to become acting National Cyber Director pending Kirsten A. Davies' Senate confirmation
stories.quote: SOURCES: JAY CLAYTON, DIRECTOR OF NATIONAL INTELLIGENCE AND AI CZAR, WILL ALSO BE ACTING NATIONAL CYBER DIRECTOR PENDING KIRSTEN A. DAVIES' SENATE CONFIRMATION

facts.text: Clayton said Americans should prepare for bumps in the road after FAA, Microsoft and bank outages
facts.quote: AFTER FAA, MICROSOFT, AND BANK OUTAGES, DNI JAY CLAYTON SAYS AMERICANS SHOULD PREPARE FOR “BUMPS IN THE ROAD” AS SYSTEMS ARE UPGRADED TO ADAPT TO THE AI AGE

stories.headline: Microsoft plans to retire its To Do app on 30 June 2027
stories.quote: MICROSOFT PLANS TO RETIRE ITS TO DO APP ON JUNE 30, 2027, OFFERING MIGRATION TO PLANNER FOR WORK AND SCHOOL ACCOUNTS, BUT NO REPLACEMENT FOR PERSONAL ACCOUNTS

stories.headline: Tesla rolls out FSD v15 with photorealistic rendering of car surroundings
stories.quote: TESLA ROLLS OUT FSD V15, FEATURING A PHOTOREALISTIC RENDERING OF CAR SURROUNDINGS; ELON MUSK SAYS IT IS REAL-TIME AI VIDEO GENERATION WITHOUT USING GAME ENGINES

stories.headline: Alice Huang reported to have been in touch with an officer of China's MSS; associates tied to AI chip smuggling to China
stories.quote: SOURCES: ALICE HUANG WAS IN TOUCH WITH AN OFFICER OF CHINA'S SPY AGENCY MSS FROM SPRING 2025 UNTIL THIS FALL; HER BUSINESS PARTNER KANG WEI ALSO WORKED WITH MSS

facts.text: Associate Li Ming, charged with fraud by Singapore in 2025, said to be central to smuggling restricted AI chips to China
facts.quote: SOURCES: ALICE HUANG ASSOCIATE LI MING, WHOM SINGAPORE CHARGED WITH FRAUD IN 2025, WAS CENTRAL TO SMUGGLING RESTRICTED AI CHIPS FROM SOUTHEAST ASIA TO CHINA

facts.text: Investigation ties Huang to a network of shell companies moving Nvidia chips to China
facts.quote: INVESTIGATION: ALICE HUANG HAD TIES TO GAMING FIRMS, ALLEGED PRINCE GROUP FIGURES AND HUNDREDS OF SHELL COMPANIES IN A NETWORK MOVING NVIDIA CHIPS TO CHINA

facts.text: Scott Bessent says Jensen Huang's return should depend on probes of Nvidia's China chip sales
facts.quote: A WEEK AFTER URGING AN NVIDIA SHAKE-UP, SCOTT BESSENT SAYS JENSEN HUANG'S RETURN SHOULD DEPEND ON PROBES OF ITS CHINA CHIP SALES AND PRESSES NVIDIA FOR ANSWERS
